lines.en: Today marks the end of the main story of ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’.
Of course, the whole story isn't over yet. There's still the epilogue.
The epilogue was originally going to follow straight away, but in my current condition, I don't think there's any way I can properly tell the stories planned for it.
So I've decided to take about a month to rest and recover. I'm very sorry. I intend to return with my mind and body at least a little restored, as someone who can write better stories.
The epilogue to Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint will begin at 7 p.m. on December 15, one month from now.
To everyone who's read this far, I'm sorry...the epilogue will be paid content
I was able to come this far because you were here, dear readers.
I hope you'll continue to support me.
